tools.name: get_solo_plan
tools.description: Use this to compare beesolo Solo pricing or check trial eligibility. Returns monthly and annual prices in minor currency units, trial length, included features, and shop and professional limits.

tools.name: get_published_booking_page
tools.description: Use this when a client knows a professional's exact beesolo slug. Returns the public service menu, prices, durations, and the link where the client can choose a time and confirm.
